name: shgb-keepalive
description: Auto next-video loop for shgb.cn via Playwright + Edge CDP (desensitized, exeable)

scripts.build:runner: bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --external playwright --external playwright-core auto-next.mjs --outfile shgb-keepalive.exe
scripts.build: npm run build:runner && npm run build:installer
